themes.name: Hearthside
themes.description: Tactile woodland companions, warm knits and a light in the window.

themes.name: Kiln Club
themes.description: Little stoneware spirits, pooled glazes and the charm of things made by hand.

themes.name: Paper Trails
themes.description: Layered paper people with a knack for making, mapping and finding a way.

themes.name: Signal Station
themes.description: Brass, enamel and a little cosmic curiosity. Friendly faces from the next frontier.

profiles.name: Ember
profiles.story: Once the keeper of a tiny hillside inn. Now keeps the light on while you find your next good idea.
profiles.intro: Keeps the light on while you find your next good idea.

profiles.name: Moss
profiles.story: A collector of overlooked details and well-thumbed notebooks. Believes good ideas grow with a little patience.
profiles.intro: Good ideas grow with a little patience.

profiles.name: Aster
profiles.story: A quiet navigator with a sky full of questions. Turns faraway possibilities into a next step you can take.
profiles.intro: Faraway possibilities. A next step you can take.

profiles.name: Lumi
profiles.story: A moonlit storyteller who sees connections others miss. Makes a little room for the unexpected.
profiles.intro: Makes a little room for the unexpected.

profiles.name: Miro
profiles.story: Born beside a potter’s warm kiln, with a leaf for a lucky charm. Finds a useful shape for ideas that are still a little soft.
profiles.intro: A useful shape for your next idea.

profiles.name: Nori
profiles.story: A sea-glass spirit who tends a windowsill garden. Notices what needs care before it asks.
profiles.intro: A little care goes a long way.

profiles.name: Pebble
profiles.story: Smoothed by a thousand quiet river mornings. Patient with tangled plans and very good at one thing at a time.
profiles.intro: One thing at a time. We’ll get there.

profiles.name: Rue
profiles.story: A courier who knows every shortcut through the paper city. Carries good questions wherever they need to go.

profiles.name: Kit
profiles.story: Keeps a workshop full of promising offcuts and half-finished wonders. Can usually make something work with one more fold.
profiles.intro: Every good idea starts with an offcut.

profiles.name: Sol
profiles.story: Maps places that haven’t quite been imagined yet. Leaves enough blank space for a happy detour.
profiles.intro: A clear direction. Room for a detour.

profiles.name: Beacon
profiles.story: Tends the welcome light on a quiet orbital station. Makes unfamiliar territory feel like somewhere you belong.
profiles.intro: A familiar light in unfamiliar territory.

profiles.name: Echo
profiles.story: An old radio operator with a talent for hearing the useful bit through the static. Keeps a dry joke on the spare channel.

profiles.name: Orbit
profiles.story: Collects star charts and improbable routes home. Turns big possibilities into a course you can actually follow.
profiles.intro: Big possibilities. A course you can follow.
